title: A Constructive Orbit-Based Theory of Learnability
abstract: arXiv:2610.41641v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We develop a finite-dimensional orbit framework for constructing data-adapted dictionaries, sparse realizations, and predictive extensions. The method uses wrapped weighted shifts to generate orbit dictionaries and local interpolation maps from independent orbit representatives, turning the learning problem into three explicit tasks: scaffold discovery, sparse realization on the discovered dictionary, and prediction through learned sparse coordinates. We introduce CCDS as the main constructive ingredient: a deviation-controlled sparse realization procedure that recovers MP/OMP-type behavior at the minimal-deviation boundary while allowing feasible interior paths with prescribed residual geometry that is inaccessible to MP/OMP. We prove generic orbit independence, exact block interpolation with norm control, observable bounds on sparse approximation distortion, sparse realization guarantees on selected supports, and fixed-path stability u

translated_title: 基于轨道的可学习性构造性理论
translated_abstract: 我们开发了一个有限维轨道框架，用于构建数据自适应字典、稀疏实现和预测扩展。该方法使用环绕加权移位从独立的轨道代表元生成轨道字典和局部插值映射，将学习问题转化为三个明确的任务：脚手架发现、在所发现字典上的稀疏实现，以及通过学习到的稀疏坐标进行预测。我们引入CCDS作为主要的构造要素：这是一种偏差控制的稀疏实现程序，它在最小偏差边界处恢复MP/OMP类型的行为，同时允许具有规定残差几何结构的可行内部路径，而这种路径是MP/OMP无法实现的。我们证明了一般轨道无关性、具有范数控制的精确块插值、稀疏逼近失真的可观测界、在选定支撑上的稀疏实现保证，以及固定路径稳定性等性质。
tldr: 本文提出了一个基于轨道的构造性可学习性理论框架，将学习分解为脚手架发现、稀疏实现和预测三个任务，并引入偏差控制的CCDS稀疏实现方法，证明了轨道无关性、精确插值和稳定性等一系列保证。
en_tdlr: A constructive orbit-based theory of learnability that decomposes learning into scaffold discovery, sparse realization, and prediction, introducing a deviation-controlled CCDS procedure with guarantees on orbit independence, exact interpolation, and stability.
